name: Tennessee

context: TN 340: cover crops are meant to reduce sheet, rill, and wind erosion, among other purposes.
TN 380: a windbreak's protected zone is 10H on the leeward side and 2H on the windward side; orient it perpendicular to the wind.
cover_rules: TN 340: maximize combined canopy and surface residue cover to at least 90-percent cover during the period of potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
TN 340: time cover crop establishment with other practices to protect the soil during critical erosion periods.
residue: TN 329: use current approved water and wind erosion prediction technology to determine whether field operations meet the erosion criteria.
seeding: TN 342: native grass mix (big bluestem, little bluestem, indiangrass) 12 lbs (4 lbs of each); optimal 4/15-5/30, dormant plantings 12/1-2/15.
TN 342: switchgrass 10 lbs with Kobe or Korean lespedeza 5 lbs; optimal 4/15-5/30, dormant plantings 12/1-2/15.
pasture: TN 512: fall mix Tall Fescue 18, White Clover 2, Red Clover 7, Annual Lespedeza 10 lbs/acre; spring 21, 2, 7, 10 lbs/acre.
TN 512: Alfalfa 20 lbs/acre with Orchardgrass 5 (fall) or 6 (spring) lbs/acre.
disturbed: TN 342: Aug-Oct Tall Fescue 40 lbs/ac with White Clover 2 lbs/ac; mulch cut slopes and concentrated flow areas.
TN 342: May-July Bermudagrass hulled 10 lbs/ac with Foxtail Millet 5 lbs/ac; success after June depends on moisture.

cover.name: Oats
cover.note: Earliest fall growth of the small grains; cold tolerance is a problem.

cover.name: Cereal rye
cover.note: Most drought resistant and cold tolerant cool season annual grass.

coverPlant.text: TN 340: with soybean leaf drop over 50% or heavy wheat residue, broadcast seeding with shallow incorporation may improve stand establishment.

seedWin.text: TN 512: recommended seeding dates, West TN optimal 2/10-3/1 and 9/1-10/1 (acceptable 2/1-4/10, 8/15-10/20).
TN 512: recommended seeding dates, West TN optimal 4/15-5/15 (acceptable 4/1-7/1); bermudagrass 5/1-6/10.
